description: Make a placeholder image of any size (up to 8000 px a side): solid background with centred text (default "W × H", "\n" for line breaks), auto-fitted font size or a fixed one, PNG / JPEG / WebP / SVG. Size presets for web, social media, IAB ads and devices. Optionally returns a data URI / tag for inlining. Text uses Inter when installed, else a system sans-serif. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/placeholder-image/

dataUri.description: Also return the image as a data URI and an tag (for small images).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

preset.description: Size preset (overrides width/height): open-graph-link-preview 1200×630, hero-16-9-full-hd 1920×1080, hd-16-9 1280×720, blog-image-4-3 800×600, thumbnail-3-2 600×400, avatar 256×256, instagram-square 1080×1080, instagram-portrait-4-5 1080×1350, story-reel-9-16 1080×1920, x-twitter-header 1500×500, linkedin-banner 1584×396, youtube-thumbnail 1280×720, medium-rectangle 300×250, leaderboard 728×90, wide-skyscraper 160×600, mobile-banner 320×50, half-page 300×600, billboard 970×250, iphone-15-screen 1179×2556, desktop-1440 1440×900, 4k-uhd 3840×2160.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

text.description: Text to show. Empty = "W × H". Use "\n" (backslash n) or a real newline for a line break.

name: image_placeholder
title: Placeholder image
